original_analysis: A conceptual C/G/R branch diagram and conditional block-order explanation distinguish input execution from amplitude control. Fresh pre-start input must be distinguished from prior reverb tails and other sources on a shared return.
limits: Not a claim that all STANDARD paths leak early or all SEND paths add a block.
Not standard reverb setup guidance and not a universal Studio event claim.
Tutorial does not handle virtual-channel removal/reconnection.
One mix block is not a fixed millisecond or end-to-end latency statement.
